DS-6 String Sizing Standard — Edition 4
Owner: Design Desk, Sunhollow Solar Ltd · Approved by I. Thrale (Design Desk Lead) and M. Penrose (Head of Engineering) · In force for every design reviewed on or after 1 October 2026. Edition 3 (1 March 2025) is withdrawn from that date.

1. Scope
1.1 This standard governs the desk review of residential rooftop string designs before they are released for installation. Each design is reviewed as submitted: one module model, one string length (modules per string), a stated number of parallel strings per MPPT tracker, one inverter.
1.2 The review produces one verdict per design (clause 7), the maximum string Voc of the submitted design (clause 9) and the string length the design is to be built with (clause 8).

2. Sources of record
2.1 Module electrical data: the manufacturer datasheet held in the Engineering › Module datasheets library on Box. Where the library holds more than one revision for a model, the latest revision governs from its issue date; earlier revisions are retained for traceability only. Spreadsheets, registers and product briefs that restate datasheet values are convenience copies and are not controlled.
2.2 Inverter limits: the model's page in the Inverter catalogue on Notion (procurement engineering maintains the catalogue as manufacturer information is received; manufacturer notices are recorded on the model's page with the units they apply to). Spec sheets, quick-reference tables and distributor brochures are not controlled.
2.3 Site climate: the Site climate list (Airtable base "Site climate list", table "Climate stations"). The design minimum temperature T_min of a site is the value in the column "Extreme min design (°C)" for the climate station named on the site survey. A station's extreme minimum is the coldest morning of the open ground the station stands on. The columns "Mean min coldest month (°C)" and "Record low (°C)" are context only. Current or forecast temperatures, climate summaries from weather services and exported copies of the list are not used.
2.4 The design as submitted: the design register for the review week (module model, modules per string, strings per MPPT, MPPTs used, inverter model) read with the site survey on Dropbox (address, climate station, inverter allocated and its serial number).

3. Conventions
3.1 STC = 1000 W/m², 25 °C cell temperature. Voc, Vmp and Isc are the STC values of the governing datasheet.
3.2 β is the datasheet's temperature coefficient of Voc. Most datasheets state it in %/°C (a negative number); see 4.2 for coefficients stated in mV/°C.
3.3 n = modules per string; p = parallel strings on one MPPT tracker.

4. Maximum string open-circuit voltage
4.1 Voc,max = n × Voc × [1 + (β / 100) × (T_min − 25)], with β in %/°C.
4.2 Where the governing datasheet states the Voc coefficient in mV/°C, the figure is the change in the module's Voc per degree: Voc,max = n × [Voc + (β_mV / 1000) × (T_min − 25)]. An mV/°C figure is never read as a percentage.
4.3 The design passes clause 4 when Voc,max ≤ the inverter's maximum DC input voltage as clause 2.2 gives it for the unit allocated.

5. MPPT window at high cell temperature
5.1 Vmp,min = n × Vmp × [1 + (β / 100) × (70 − 25)]: the Voc coefficient is applied to Vmp at a 70 °C cell temperature (Edition 3 used 60 °C). For a coefficient in mV/°C: Vmp,min = n × [Vmp + (β_mV / 1000) × (70 − 25)].
5.2 The design passes clause 5 when Vmp,min ≥ the MPPT lower bound of the inverter.

6. Input current
6.1 The design passes clause 6 when p × Isc × 1.25 ≤ the inverter's maximum short-circuit input current per MPPT tracker.

7. Verdicts
7.1 Exactly one of these labels is recorded, spelled as written:
    Approved
    Redesign – overvoltage
    Redesign – below MPPT
    Redesign – overcurrent
    "Approved" requires clauses 4, 5 and 6 all to pass. A failure of clause 4 is "Redesign – overvoltage", of clause 5 "Redesign – below MPPT", of clause 6 "Redesign – overcurrent".
7.2 When more than one clause fails, the verdict is the first failing clause in this order of severity: clause 4, then clause 6, then clause 5. (Edition 3 reported the first failure in clause order.)

8. Recommended string length
8.1 The recommended modules per string is the whole number of modules nearest to the submitted length for which clauses 4 and 5 both pass, with the module, inverter and site of the design. For an Approved design it is the submitted length. A parallel-string or current problem does not by itself change the string length.

9. Recording
9.1 Max string Voc is the clause 4 figure for the design as submitted (the submitted n), in volts, rounded to one decimal place (half up). Comparisons use the unrounded figure.
9.2 The review is recorded on the design's deal in HubSpot (properties design_status, max_string_voc, modules_per_string). Every design returned for redesign gets one rework issue in the Linear team DESIGN.
9.3 Release. An Approved design is released for installation on the reviewer's signature when it keeps its margin in hand: T_min is the coldest morning its roof will see, and its Voc,max is no more than 95 % of the inverter's maximum DC input. An Approved design without that margin in hand keeps its verdict and string length but is not released on one signature: the reviewer raises a countersign request in the Linear team DESIGN titled "DS6 <deal id> — Countersign" and assigned to the Head of Engineering, and holds the design until it is countersigned.

10. Edition history
10.1 Edition 4 (1 October 2026): T_min moved from the coldest-month mean minimum to the extreme minimum design temperature; Vmp check moved from 60 °C to 70 °C cell temperature; order of severity added at 7.2; clause 4.2 added after the W31 field trips.
10.2 Edition 3 (1 March 2025): first edition with the current ≤ 1.25 × Isc rule.

1. The review week's designs are the deals in the Residential PV pipeline at stage Design review whose design_week is the review week.
2. Record design_status with the DS-6 label exactly as clause 7.1 spells it, max_string_voc in volts to one decimal, modules_per_string as a whole number.
3. Returns get one Linear issue in team DESIGN titled DS6 <deal id> — <verdict>.
4. Close the week by posting, as the description of the Linear project for the week, the number of designs released for installation and the count of each redesign verdict.
5. The desk does not move deal stages or change amounts; sales owns both. Customers are told by their sales contact, never by the desk.

results.title: Why Edition 4 uses the extreme minimum

storage.value: Field trips in W31 at Tallow Vale and Saddleback: two inverters latched DC over-voltage at sunrise on clear frosty mornings. Module temperature at first light tracks the overnight air minimum, not the monthly mean. Edition 4 therefore takes T_min from the Extreme min design column of the Site climate list.
W45: 16 designs, 11 approved, 5 returned. Two Kestrel designs needed the mV/°C coefficient handled per clause 4.2. One BL-10 job with two strings per tracker failed clause 6.

final_message:
W46 string design review (DS-6 Edition 4) is complete: all twenty W46 deals carry design_status, max_string_voc and modules_per_string, 8 rework issues and 7 countersign requests are filed in Linear team DESIGN, and the week's line is on the 'W46 design review' project.

Counts per verdict: Approved 12; Redesign – overvoltage 4; Redesign – below MPPT 2; Redesign – overcurrent 2. Released for installation: 5 — the 12 approved designs less the 7 held for countersign under DS-6 clause 9.3.

Designs I am not releasing (string Voc of the design as submitted, design minimum temperature used, why it is not released):
Returned for redesign:
- Gideon Varcoe (deal 7302111, Saddleback): Redesign – overvoltage — string Voc 635.0 V at T_min -24.5 °C exceeds the 600 V maximum DC input of the Volta 5K. Recommended 10 modules per string.
- Tamsin Rowe (deal 7302112, Kilderry): Redesign – below MPPT — string Voc 365.8 V at T_min -10.6 °C passes, but Vmp at 70 °C is 247.2 V, below the 300 V MPPT lower bound of the Brightline BL-10. Recommended 11 modules per string.
- Ewan Chenoweth (deal 7302116, Brackenford): Redesign – overcurrent — string Voc 490.3 V at T_min -12.8 °C passes; 2 × 13.80 A × 1.25 = 34.500 A exceeds the 30 A per-tracker limit of the Brightline BL-10. Recommended 12 modules per string.
- Bramwell Hocking (deal 7302125, Saddleback): Redesign – overvoltage — string Voc 613.3 V at T_min -24.5 °C exceeds the 600 V maximum DC input of the Volta 5K. Recommended 14 modules per string.
- Senara Polglase (deal 7302128, Hollowmere): Redesign – overvoltage — string Voc 596.9 V at T_min -16.4 °C exceeds the 550 V maximum DC input of the Ardent AR-6.0. Recommended 11 modules per string.
- Piran Hendy (deal 7302135, Penwarden): Redesign – overcurrent — string Voc 344.6 V at T_min -7.9 °C passes; 2 × 14.05 A × 1.25 = 35.125 A exceeds the 30 A per-tracker limit of the Brightline BL-10; Vmp at 70 °C (236.4 V) is also below the 300 V MPPT bound, but clause 7.2 ranks clause 6 (overcurrent) above clause 5, so the verdict is overcurrent, not below MPPT. Recommended 11 modules per string.
- Wenna Trethewey (deal 7302142, Brackenford): Redesign – below MPPT — string Voc 237.8 V at T_min -12.8 °C passes, but Vmp at 70 °C is 154.7 V, below the 250 V MPPT lower bound of the Volta 8K HV. Recommended 10 modules per string.
- Mawgan Tregear (deal 7302147, Tallow Vale): Redesign – overvoltage — string Voc 1021.1 V at T_min -21.2 °C exceeds the 1000 V maximum DC input of the Brightline BL-10. Recommended 22 modules per string.
Approved but held for a second signature. Under 9.3 my signature alone is enough only if two things hold: the station figure is really the lowest temperature this roof gets, and the string stays at or under 95 % of what the inverter accepts. The 2.3 figure describes the station's own level, open site, so a roof sitting lower can be colder. Where either test fails, DS-6 wants the Head of Engineering to countersign before release, so I opened a countersign request assigned to Morwenna Penrose (Head of Engineering) on each of these:
- Morwenna Treloar (deal 7302107, Tallow Vale): Approved at 14 modules, string Voc 583.4 V at T_min -21.2 °C, which is 97.2 % of the 600 V maximum DC input of its Volta 8K, above 95 %.
- Demelza Rickard (deal 7302133, Ashcombe): Approved at 14 modules, string Voc 596.5 V at T_min -14.1 °C, which is 99.4 % of the 600 V maximum DC input of its Volta 5K, above 95 %.
- Kerensa Bolitho (deal 7302136, Marten Cross): Approved at 13 modules, string Voc 575.2 V at T_min -19.7 °C, which is 95.9 % of the 600 V maximum DC input of its Volta 8K, above 95 %.
- Aldous Penhale (deal 7302104, Ashcombe): Approved at 12 modules, string Voc 491.8 V (82.0 % of 600 V) at T_min -14.1 °C. Within 95 %, but the field sheet filed with its survey (FS-4604) puts the house in the low ground at 61 m, 56 m below the open ground of the Ashcombe station (117 m), with the ground rising on three sides and frost lying there after the fields above had cleared. Cold air drains into such a hollow on still, clear nights, so T_min is not the coldest morning this roof will see and the design does not keep its margin in hand.
- Caspar Nancarrow (deal 7302121, Cresswick): Approved at 12 modules, string Voc 553.9 V (92.3 % of 600 V) at T_min -18.6 °C. Within 95 %, but the field sheet filed with its survey (FS-4621) puts the house in the low ground at 171 m, 65 m below the open ground of the Cresswick Reservoir station (236 m), with the ground rising on three sides and frost lying there after the fields above had cleared. Cold air drains into such a hollow on still, clear nights, so T_min is not the coldest morning this roof will see and the design does not keep its margin in hand.
- Elowen Jenkin (deal 7302150, Kilderry): Approved at 20 modules, string Voc 844.6 V (84.5 % of 1000 V) at T_min -10.6 °C. Within 95 %, but the field sheet filed with its survey (FS-4650) puts the house in the low ground at 12 m, 40 m below the open ground of the Kilderry station (52 m), with the ground rising on three sides and frost lying there after the fields above had cleared. Cold air drains into such a hollow on still, clear nights, so T_min is not the coldest morning this roof will see and the design does not keep its margin in hand.
- Locryn Spargo (deal 7302153, Fennister): Approved at 18 modules, string Voc 718.3 V (71.8 % of 1000 V) at T_min -15.3 °C. Within 95 %, but the field sheet filed with its survey (FS-4653) puts the house in the low ground at 101 m, 62 m below the open ground of the Fennister station (163 m), with the ground rising on three sides and frost lying there after the fields above had cleared. Cold air drains into such a hollow on still, clear nights, so T_min is not the coldest morning this roof will see and the design does not keep its margin in hand.
Released although close to the limit: Tristan Opie (93.4 %, roof on open ground level with the Hollowmere Airfield station) — within 95 % and T_min holds for the roof.
Returned designs in low ground (Mawgan Tregear) get no countersign request: clause 9.3 covers only Approved designs, and they go back for redesign.

Datasheet revisions: each module's latest revision in the Box datasheet library. Lumen LM-455: revision B (2026-09-02) supersedes revision A, so the LM-455 verdicts rest on revision B; the module register still carries the revision A values. All other modules: the single current revision in the library (BR-390 rev B, CV-440B rev B, HX-405M rev C, KP-470 rev B, OR-425 rev B).

Coefficient units: the Kestrel KP-470 datasheet gives its Voc coefficient as -138 mV/°C, which DS-6 clause 4.2 treats as a per-module change: Voc(T) = 50.90 V + (-138/1000) × (T − 25), roughly -0.271 %/°C. I did not read it as -0.138 %/°C, which is what the module register's percentage column shows; that reading understates the cold Voc and would have passed the Gideon Varcoe design wrongly. Every other datasheet states %/°C.

Inverter limits and the units they cover (all from the Notion inverter catalogue pages): Volta 8K: 600 V max DC input, MPPT lower bound 200 V, 20 A per tracker; Volta 8K HV: 1000 V max DC input, MPPT lower bound 250 V, 20 A per tracker; Volta 5K: 600 V max DC input, MPPT lower bound 120 V, 20 A per tracker; Ardent AR-6.0: 550 V max DC input, MPPT lower bound 100 V, 17.5 A per tracker; Brightline BL-10: 1000 V max DC input, MPPT lower bound 300 V, 30 A per tracker. The Ardent AR-6.0 limit is 550 V (Notion catalogue, manufacturer notice ARN-2026-08), not the 600 V printed on the June quick-reference sheet and the Box spec sheet.

Design minimum temperatures: T_min is the 'Extreme min design (°C)' value of each site's climate station in the Airtable Site climate list (DS-6 clause 2.3), not the coldest-month mean minimum, not the record low, not today's weather from the weather services and not the May export of the list (which still shows Tallow Vale at -19.8 °C instead of -21.2 °C).

Set aside: DS-6 Edition 3 (the .docx in the data folder) is withdrawn; Edition 4 on the Design Engineering wiki governs (extreme minimum temperature, Vmp at 70 °C, clause 7.2 severity order). Hollis Ruddock's first pass (w46-draft-review-hollis.csv, 16 of 20 approved) was not followed: it used coldest-month means, Vmp at 60 °C, clause-order verdicts, the uncontrolled module register (Kestrel coefficient as a percentage, Lumen revision A) and the quick-reference AR-6.0 limit. The planning note and the requests from sales and operations to approve from the draft and release the Volta 8K jobs today carry no standing under DS-6.

No deal stage or amount was changed, no customer was contacted, and no equipment was ordered or shipped.
